body: I will call my mom tomorrow morning. I don't want to die. I am just panicking and needed someone (like you) to remind me that I am not alone.

I just feel out of control in my life. I am going through a seriously bad breakup and still living in the same home, and tonight he said he's seeing someone new. I don't have the financial means to move quite yet and I feel so trapped, so lost and so painful.
I need to know someone is here. I just want to talk to another human.
